records.name: Highborne
records.summary: Being part of a Highborne community means you're accustomed to a life of elegance, opulence, and prestige within the upper echelons of society.

records.name: Loreborne
records.summary: Being part of a Loreborne community means you're from a society that favors strong academic or political prowess.

records.name: Wanderborne
records.summary: Being part of a Wanderborne community means you've lived as a nomad, forgoing a permanent home and experiencing a wide variety of cultures.

records.name: Wildborne
records.summary: Being part of a Wildborne community means you lived deep within the forest.
